run_suite_generate_gt: run the diffusion CI output generator for a test suite and generate ground truth outputs
run_suite_partition_tests: run the diffusion CI output generator with partition-id and total-partitions to split test items across workers
run_suite_filter_cases: run the diffusion CI output generator filtering by specific case IDs like qwen_image_t2i and flux_image_t2i
run_suite_continue_on_error: run the diffusion CI output generator with --continue-on-error to skip failed cases and process remaining ones
run_suite_specify_output_dir: run the diffusion CI output generator writing generated files to a custom output directory
